items.name: Montevideo en Llamas 2021

venue.name: [Grupo Altavista Lab & Trend](https://www.grupoaltavista.com.uy/)
venue.address: Av. Uruguay 1529, 11200 Montevideo, Departamento de Montevideo.
venue.details: At the entrance you will see the competition.

items.information:
**Español:**
NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19.
Hay un límite de 30 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores y sin importar los tiempos de resolución.
* Por razones sanitarias, no estarán permitidos los acompañantes a menos que sea necesario y esté justificado debidamente (p.ej. menores de edad). De ser posible los acompañantes deberán permanecer fuera del local.
* La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes, además, se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA.
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles, de acuerdo con el punto 2.6 de la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf).
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la categoría, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo al artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.

**¡Importante!**

**La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.**

Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. 

**English:**
YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF THE COVID-19.
Competitor limit: 30.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). In that case, guests should remain outdoors.
* Competition will be held in accordance with the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)). Please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue.
* Competitors must provide their own puzzles in accordance with 2.6 of the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf).
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.

**Attention!**

**The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.**

For any question, feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.name: Richmond Open B 2021
items.information:
As per BC's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/covid-19/vaccine/proof), All attendees are required to have **FULL vaccination (2 doses)** by the event date otherwise, you will NOT be allowed to enter the venue.

Please **review ALL of the tabs listed on this website**. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new shifts** and there are things to be particularly attentive to.

Note that this is a **one of a pair of series competitions**. Series competitions (formerly known as twin competitions) are relatively new to BC. Please see the Series Competiton Tab for more information.

Take clear note especially of the Health and Safety Tab, containing our Risk Mitigation Plan.

Note: **Spectators (max 1 per competitor)** can attend for free.  Those aged 18+ are invited to consider not attending with a guest to help our venue capacity numbers as low as possible. **If you're not a competitor, nor the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.**

Note: As the pandemic is an ever-evolving situation, there is of course the possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions or, in the worst case, cancel the competition. **Please be aware that changes may be needed.** Email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes. In the event of cancellation we will do our best to provide full refunds to everyone.

items.name: Veenendaal Open 2021
items.information:
Wedstrijd met coronatoegangsbewijs en aanvullende WCA safety maatregelen. Maximaal 1 begeleider per deelnemer (van te voren aanmelden via het betaalformulier). Alle deelnemers en bezoekers van 13 jaar en ouder hebben een coronatoegangsbewijs nodig én moeten een ID-bewijs kunnen tonen. Voor deelnemers van 6-12 jaar geldt het advies om van te voren een zelftest af te nemen. 
Zie https://www.rijksoverheid.nl/onderwerpen/coronavirus-covid-19/cultuur-uitgaan-en-sport/coronatoegangsbewijs
en https://coronacheck.nl/nl/faq-scanner
____
Competition with 'coronatoegangsbewijs' and additonal WCA safety measures. Max. 1 companion per competitor (register in advance via the payment form). For all competitors and visitors of 13 years and older, the 'coronatoegangsbewijs' ánd ID-card is mandatory. For competitors of age 6-12 years it is recommended to do a selftest before the event. 
See https://coronacheck.nl/en/faq-scanner
